findings: auto_record.rs snapshot() iterates configured channels and ScheduledCapture runs only. A manually recording viewer cannot appear there, so colors alone leave item6 incomplete.

YouTubeOriginalPlayer already reads open/snapshot through one existing1500ms single-flight poll. OriginalSnapshot contains current recordingJob and recordingStopping; native controls already use these values. No second poll, recording command or job enumeration is needed for an attached viewer.

OriginalSnapshot.channelId and broadcastId are both the exact video ID, not a UC channel ID. Native Session.canonical_channel is already validated by lease.bind_youtube_chat for the current video under the arm/epoch gate. It is reset on original-document load. metadata.authorUrl often carries an @handle, so treating that as equivalent to a saved UC ID would be a guess.

The source recording job becomes null after encoded_finish dispatches finalization. Therefore recordingStopping supports only the observed stop/drain phase, not a claim that all later finalization is complete. Once the native observation is absent, keep automatic status where available and otherwise honest unknown/off reservation wording; never report recording success from this UI projection.

observationProtocol.callback: Optional onObservation(event), with closed frontend shape: instanceId (per mounted component), attempt (existing open generation), videoId, token, state, canonicalChannelId, recordingJob, recordingStopping; event kinds begin/update/clear. It is local React data, not new IPC. No account or error text is propagated.
observationProtocol.source: Publish only existing open/snapshot replies that pass current generation/gone checks plus exact token and channelId/broadcastId==requested videoId. Poll is already single-flight; do not add timers or queries. Callback stored in a ref so parent updates do not reopen the native receiver. VOD publishes no live recording observation.
observationProtocol.lifetime: Begin registers the exact mounted instance/attempt before opening. Update requires the currently registered instance/attempt/token and currently playing video membership. Cleanup clears only the exact instance/attempt/token; an old close or late reply cannot delete/repopulate a replacement viewer. Failed poll clears known recording observation for that attempt until a later accepted reply; it must not leave a stale red badge indefinitely. Changing a callback prop must not change source lifetime.
observationProtocol.transitions: Keep only the latest accepted job state per viewer; job A->null->job B cannot be regressed by an old attempt or older response. No optimistic recording from a button click. Parent keeps at most4 current viewer observations; removing a viewer removes its display observation, never stops its recording or clears scheduled state. Privacy masks all new status text/colors while retained playback/poll behavior remains unchanged.

identityAndStatus: Video favorite matches exact video ID. Canonical channel favorite matches optional validated UC ID.
